title: Minor child EDB — clock starts at 21
catches: 10-year clock started at the date of death for a minor child of the owner.
notes: Child turns 21 in 2036, 31 in 2046. Annual life-expectancy payments until 21, then full payout by Dec 31 of the year the child turns 31. CHILD OF THE OWNER ONLY - a grandchild or niece is not an EDB under this rule.
